_comment: EXPERIMENT: optional extra quests. Not original game content. Stage lists name BOTH worlds where a place exists twice (Asuka and Amaterasu), and night/story variants count as the same place, so a quest works whichever world the story is in. Species, stage ids, coordinates and item names are checked against the game's own data by tools/check_quests.py. 'acceptAt' makes a quest acceptable only while standing in that place (a notice board, in effect).

quests.title: Central Park pest control
quests.text: Kunemon keep wandering into Central Park. Thin them out.

quests.title: Wire Forest survey
quests.text: Walk the Wire Forest entrance and the forest beyond it, and report back.

quests.text: Plants are overrunning the Kicking Forest path. Cut four of them back.

quests.text: The Bulk Swamp crossing is infested. Clear four of the worst offenders.

quests.title: The quiet route
quests.text: Couriers lose time to fights in the Wire Forest. Show a fight-free way through.

objectives.label: Cross the Wire Forest entrance from the north-west gate to the south gate without a fight
